chapters.title: 序 · 你的命盤
chapters.zh:
你出生的那一刻，在這裡換算成一張命盤。十二宮的位置由此定下，往後每一章，都從這張盤讀起。

國曆一九九〇年三月二十一日，未時，生於香港。農曆庚午年二月廿五。

五行局是水二局。命宮在申，身宮在戌。十二宮由此定位，往後每一章各讀其中一宮。

這張盤依中州派（王亭之）的算法排出。出生時間已按出生地經度，校正為真太陽時。

這張盤是屬於你的底圖，一生不變。往後翻開的每一章，讀的都是你自己。
chapters.en:
The moment you were born is turned here into a chart. It fixes where the twelve palaces sit, and every chapter that follows is read from this chart.

Born 21 March 1990, in the Wei hour (1 – 3 pm), in Hong Kong. By the lunar calendar: the 25th day of the 2nd month, in the Geng Wu year.

Your Five-Element Bureau is the Water Two Bureau. Your Life Palace sits in Shen, and your Body Palace in Xu. This places the twelve palaces, and each of the chapters that follow reads one of them.

This chart is calculated by the method of the Zhongzhou School (Wang Tingzhi). Your birth time has been adjusted to true solar time for the longitude of your birthplace.

This chart is your own base map, and it doesn't change over your lifetime. Every chapter you open from here on is a reading of you.

chapters.title: 一 · 命宮
chapters.zh:
你性格和緩：不爭先、不記仇，很懂得把日子過得舒服。要留意的是：舒服會削弱你前進的動力，有時你需要一點外來的推力。

你的命宮坐天同、天梁。

天同的課題不在苦，在動力——舒服本身會削弱移動的理由。有一點壓力，對你反而是好事。福氣厚，日子過得舒服，人緣寬，不必用力也有人願意幫。它的舒服是真的，不必替它擔心。天梁在命的基調是出面：遇到不公會說話，遇到有難的人會接。它有一套自己認定的標準，而且相當堅持。天同化忌，想安頓而安頓不下，舒服的條件恰好最缺。它的形狀是拖而不是痛。

同宮還有火星：性急，起手快；熱度來得猛，退得也快。

同一種底色，延伸到盤上別處：在外時，天同在陌生環境裡討人喜歡；工作上，天機的做事方式是拆解與變通；錢方面，太陰處理資源的方式是慢慢積。

放假時你最懂得享受，一頓好飯、一個午覺就很滿足；只是舒服的位置坐久了，換工作、學新東西，往往要別人推你一把。
chapters.en:
You are easy-going by nature. You don't compete for attention, you don't hold on to resentment, and you have a real instinct for making life comfortable. But that ease has a cost: when life is too comfortable your drive softens, and change comes more easily when something outside pushes you.

Your Life Palace is shaped by Tian Tong (the Blessed) and Tian Liang (the Sage).

For Tian Tong, the challenge is not hardship but drive — when nothing forces you to move, comfort itself weakens your reasons to. A certain amount of pressure actually works in your favour. You are well blessed: life is comfortable, you get on easily with people, and help comes without your having to push for it. That ease is genuine; there's no need to distrust it. Tian Liang in the Life Palace makes stepping forward your keynote: you speak up when something is unfair, and you take in people who are struggling. You hold to a set of standards of your own, and you don't bend them easily. Here Tian Tong turns to Obstruction: you want to settle, yet the very conditions for ease are the ones hardest to come by. What you feel is less pain than a recurring drag.

Huo Xing (Fire) also sits here, adding heat and speed: quick-tempered and quick to start; your enthusiasm flares fast and fades just as fast.

The same pattern carries into other parts of the chart. Out in the world, Tian Tong makes you easy to warm to in unfamiliar places. At work, Tian Ji (the Strategist) has you take a problem apart and find another way through. With money, Tai Yin (the Moon) has you build up slowly and steadily.

You know how to enjoy rest — a good meal and an afternoon nap are enough to make you content. But stay somewhere comfortable for too long, and big changes, like a new job or learning something new, usually need someone else's push first.

chapters.title: 性格的骨架
chapters.zh:
你有自己的節奏，不急不躁，適合在穩定的環境裡發揮。

你的長處是穩當、可靠，做事有條理。要留意的是：你選擇工作和環境時，先想清楚自己要悠閒還是要進取。

你的命宮在申，坐天同、天梁。天同天梁同宮，會天機、太陰，成為純粹的機月同梁格局。天同帶浪漫，天梁講原則，你偏向哪一邊，對你的去留出處影響很大。

骨架是天生的，長成怎樣的人，看你怎樣用它；用在對的地方，同一副骨架就是長處。
chapters.en:
You have your own pace, unhurried and even, and you do best in a stable environment.

Your strength is being steady and reliable, with an orderly way of working. Keep in mind that, when choosing work and surroundings, it helps to be clear whether you want ease or ambition.

Your Life Palace sits in Shen, shaped by Tian Tong (the Blessed) and Tian Liang (the Sage). Tian Tong with Tian Liang, joined by Tian Ji (the Strategist) and Tai Yin (the Moon), forms a pure Ji Yue Tong Liang pattern. Tian Tong brings romance and Tian Liang principle, and which way you lean has a big effect on where you go and when you stay.

The shape is what you were born with; who you become depends on how you use it, and used in the right place, the same shape is a strength.

chapters.title: 三方四正
chapters.zh:
你偏向原則：你講紀律、守規矩，在有章法的環境裡最能施展。

這樣看，是因為你的盤上有天梁同宮見火星，推你偏向原則；推你偏向浪漫的，一樣也沒有。

推力不等於定局。哪一股力量在你身上用得多，你自己最清楚。
chapters.en:
You lean towards principle: disciplined and rule-abiding, at your best where there's a clear method.

This is because your chart has Tian Liang (the Sage) sharing a palace with Huo Xing, pushing you towards principle; nothing in it pushes you towards romance.

A push is not a verdict. You know best which of these forces you use more.

chapters.title: 身宮與五行局
chapters.titleEn: The Body Palace and the Five-Element Bureau
chapters.zh:
你把力氣放在內在：安不安頓，比做成了甚麼更影響你的狀態。

你的身宮落在福德宮，坐太陽。你的身宮有化祿：你用力的地方比較順，付出容易有回報。

你是水二局。大限由虛歲二歲起，每十年一步。寫這本書時（二〇二六年），你虛歲三十七，正行第四個大限（三十二至四十一歲），落在子女宮，坐廉貞、貪狼。下一個大限從虛歲四十二歲開始，轉到財帛宮。

身宮所在，就是你這些年最用力的地方；力氣用在這裡，最容易見到回報。
chapters.en:
You put your effort inwards: whether you feel settled affects you more than what you've achieved.

Your Body Palace falls in your Wellbeing Palace, shaped by Tai Yang (the Sun). Abundance in your Body Palace means the places you put effort into go relatively smoothly, and what you give tends to come back.

You belong to the Water Two Bureau. Your ten-year stages begin at around age 1 (2 by Chinese reckoning), and move on every ten years. When this book was written (2026), you were 35 or 36 (37 by Chinese reckoning), in your fourth ten-year stage (roughly ages 31 to 40; 32–41 by Chinese reckoning). It falls in your Children Palace, shaped by Lian Zhen (the Upright) and Tan Lang (the Wolf). The next one begins at around age 41 (42 by Chinese reckoning) and moves to your Wealth Palace.

Where your Body Palace sits is where you've put the most effort in these years; effort spent here is the most likely to pay off.

chapters.title: 一生十二步
chapters.zh:
你的大限由虛歲二歲起，每十年換一步；寫這本書時（二〇二六年），你走到第四步。你命盤裡的關鍵大限是第三步、第五步：這幾步的得失，對你一生影響特別大。

回看你走過的路：二〇一四年（甲午年，你虛歲二十五），是你命盤裡關鍵的一年：容易捲入是非爭拗，有些事要靠白紙黑字、找人評理才解決；同一年，朋輩之間比較得力。二〇一八年（戊戌年，你虛歲二十九），同樣是關鍵的一年：心事較多，不容易靜下來，像是心裡有放不下的事，夜裡想個不停。二〇二四年（甲辰年，你虛歲三十五），同樣是關鍵的一年：出入、出行要格外小心，容易有磕碰，或者行程上的波折；同一年，和長輩或上司之間比較順。這幾年，對你來說是不是有過轉折？

第一步　二至十一歲　命宮，坐天同、天梁。

第二步　十二至二十一歲　兄弟宮，坐天相。

第三步　二十二至三十一歲　夫妻宮，坐巨門。　關鍵大限。

第四步　三十二至四十一歲　子女宮，坐廉貞、貪狼。　寫這本書時，你在這一步。

第五步　四十二至五十一歲　財帛宮，坐太陰。　關鍵大限。

第六步　五十二至六十一歲　疾厄宮，坐天府。

第七步　六十二至七十一歲　遷移宮，沒有主星，借對宮的天同、天梁。

第八步　七十二至八十一歲　僕役宮，坐紫微、破軍。

第九步　八十二至九十一歲　官祿宮，坐天機。

之後的大限從虛歲九十二歲起，這裡不再細列。

十二步是一條路的形狀，走得快慢、走向哪裡，仍然在你；關鍵的幾步，值得提早準備。
chapters.en:
Your ten-year stages begin at around age 1 (2 by Chinese reckoning) and move on every ten years; when this book was written (2026), you were on the fourth step. The key stages in your chart are the third and fifth steps: what you gain and lose in them shapes your life more than anything else.

Looking back on the road you've walked: 2014 (a Jia Wu year, when you were 23 or 24) was a key year in your chart: you were more easily drawn into disputes, and some could only be settled in writing or by bringing in someone to judge; in the same year, your peers were a real help. 2018 (a Wu Xu year, when you were 27 or 28) was another key year in your chart: you had more on your mind and found it hard to settle, for example, something you couldn't let go of, turning things over at night. 2024 (a Jia Chen year, when you were 33 or 34) was another key year in your chart: getting about and travelling called for extra care, with knocks or setbacks along the way more likely; in the same year, things went relatively smoothly with elders or bosses. Were these years turning points for you?

Step 1 — roughly ages 1 to 10; 2–11 by Chinese reckoning — your Life Palace, shaped by Tian Tong (the Blessed) and Tian Liang (the Sage).

Step 2 — roughly ages 11 to 20; 12–21 by Chinese reckoning — your Siblings Palace, shaped by Tian Xiang (the Minister).

Step 3 — roughly ages 21 to 30; 22–31 by Chinese reckoning — your Partnership Palace, shaped by Ju Men (the Great Gate). A key stage.

Step 4 — roughly ages 31 to 40; 32–41 by Chinese reckoning — your Children Palace, shaped by Lian Zhen (the Upright) and Tan Lang (the Wolf). You were on this step when this book was written.

Step 5 — roughly ages 41 to 50; 42–51 by Chinese reckoning — your Wealth Palace, shaped by Tai Yin (the Moon). A key stage.

Step 6 — roughly ages 51 to 60; 52–61 by Chinese reckoning — your Health Palace, shaped by Tian Fu (the Treasury).

Step 7 — roughly ages 61 to 70; 62–71 by Chinese reckoning — your Travel Palace, which has no major star and borrows Tian Tong and Tian Liang from the opposite palace.

Step 8 — roughly ages 71 to 80; 72–81 by Chinese reckoning — your Friends Palace, shaped by Zi Wei (the Emperor) and Po Jun (the Vanguard).

Step 9 — roughly ages 81 to 90; 82–91 by Chinese reckoning — your Career Palace, shaped by Tian Ji (the Strategist).

The stages after that begin at around age 91 (92 by Chinese reckoning) and aren't listed here.

The twelve steps are the shape of a road; how fast you walk it and where you head are still up to you, and the key steps are worth preparing for early.

chapters.title: 這十年
chapters.zh:
寫這本書時（二〇二六年），你虛歲三十七，正行第四個大限（三十二至四十一歲）。這十年，你的長輩關係比較順，感情要多留神。

這個大限落在你的子女宮，坐廉貞、貪狼，宮干是辛。這十年裡，你偏向物欲：你重實際、重享受，目標具體，也肯為它出力。

這十年，你做事直取目標，路徑越短越好。只是你在需要協調多方、講究人情的位置上，容易和人碰撞。（依據：大限的官祿宮坐武曲、七殺。）

這十年，你花錢講體面：該花的不省，不想讓人看見拮据。只是你維持某個水準，本身就是一項固定開支。（依據：大限的財帛宮坐紫微、破軍。）

感情上，這十年要多留神。你把感情當作要守住的東西，用穩定去維持關係。只是關係出現不確定時，你先收緊，不如先談開。（依據：大限的夫妻宮坐天府；文昌化忌落在這裡。）感情上容易有誤會，或有心事說不出口；有話早點講清楚。

心境上，這十年你要事情各就各位、沒有亂，才安心。只是真正令你不安的不是忙，是規矩改了、角色模糊了。（依據：大限的福德宮坐天相。）

四化各自的意思：巨門化祿（在這十年的父母宮）：你的口才變成本錢，利於教學、法律、銷售、傳播；太想表現自己，反而容易惹是非。太陽化權（在這十年的僕役宮）：你的地位和領導力提升，收入跟著地位增加；不宜過份擴張聲勢。文曲化科（在這十年的遷移宮）：你的口才和學雜學的能力增加，容易以言詞取悅別人。文昌化忌（在這十年的夫妻宮）：你的文書、考試和合約容易出錯，替人擔保或借貸要特別小心。

這十年最值得做的事：長輩關係方面是這十年最順的地方，值得多花心思；感情方面的決定，多花一點時間再定，簽字、承諾之前多問一句。

下一個大限從虛歲四十二歲開始，轉到財帛宮，坐太陰；那十年太陽化祿、天同化忌。

環境只是背景；這十年要做成甚麼、做到哪一步，始終由你自己決定。
chapters.en:
When this book was written (2026), you were 35 or 36 (37 by Chinese reckoning), in your fourth ten-year stage (roughly ages 31 to 40; 32–41 by Chinese reckoning). Over these ten years, it's smoother going for your ties with elders, and more care is needed with your love life.

This stage falls in your Children Palace, shaped by Lian Zhen (the Upright) and Tan Lang (the Wolf), and its palace stem is Xin. During these ten years, you lean towards material desire: practical and pleasure-loving, with concrete goals you're willing to work for.

Over these ten years, at work you go straight for the goal; the shorter the path, the better. That said, in roles that mean balancing many parties and minding feelings, you'll clash with people. (Basis: the decade's Career Palace holds Wu Qu (the General) and Qi Sha (the Warrior).)

Over these ten years, you spend with an eye to appearances: you don't skimp where it matters, and you don't want anyone to see you short. That said, keeping up a certain standard is itself a fixed cost. (Basis: the decade's Wealth Palace holds Zi Wei (the Emperor) and Po Jun (the Vanguard).)

In love, these ten years call for extra care. You treat love as something to protect, and you keep a relationship going through steadiness. That said, when a relationship feels uncertain, talking it through will serve you better than tightening your hold. (Basis: the decade's Partnership Palace holds Tian Fu (the Treasury); Wen Chang turning to Obstruction falls here.) Misunderstandings in love are more likely, or things go unsaid; say what you need to say early.

In your inner life, over these ten years, you only feel at ease when everything is in its place and nothing is in a muddle. That said, what really unsettles you isn't being busy; it's rules changing and roles blurring. (Basis: the decade's Wellbeing Palace holds Tian Xiang (the Minister).)

What each transformation means: Ju Men (the Great Gate) turns to Abundance (in this decade's Parents Palace): your way with words becomes an asset, favouring teaching, law, sales and media; wanting too much to show yourself off can draw disputes. Tai Yang (the Sun) turns to Authority (in this decade's Friends Palace): your standing and leadership rise, and income grows with your standing; don't overextend your influence. Wen Qu turns to Recognition (in this decade's Travel Palace): your way with words and your knack for picking up varied knowledge grow, and you can easily please people with what you say. Wen Chang turns to Obstruction (in this decade's Partnership Palace): mistakes can creep into your paperwork, exams and contracts, so take special care with guaranteeing others or lending.

The most worthwhile thing to do in these ten years: when it comes to your ties with elders, these ten years run most smoothly, so it's worth giving it extra thought; with decisions about your love life, take a little more time, and ask one more question before you sign or commit to anything.

The next stage begins at around age 41 (42 by Chinese reckoning) and moves to your Wealth Palace, shaped by Tai Yin (the Moon); in that decade, Tai Yang turns to Abundance and Tian Tong (the Blessed) to Obstruction.

Circumstances are only the backdrop; what you make of these ten years, and how far you take it, is always your own decision.

chapters.title: 這一年
chapters.zh:
寫這本書的二〇二六年是丙午年，你虛歲三十七。這一年，你的心境比較順，朋輩要多留神。這一年是你命盤裡的關鍵年份之一，今年的得失，影響會比一般年份深。

這一年的流年命宮在午，落在你本命的夫妻宮，也就是這十年大限的父母宮，坐巨門。這一年裡，你懂得收斂，也懂得防人，分寸在於何時放下戒心。

這一年，你做事喜歡站到前面，對外、對人的位置最合你用。只是你推得動事情，未必收得了尾。（依據：流年的官祿宮坐太陽。）

這一年，你對錢是夠用就好：錢多花得舒服，錢緊也忍得住。只是你很少替自己的財務定目標，累積多半要靠時間。（依據：流年的財帛宮沒有主星，借對宮的天同、天梁。）

這一年，你在感情裡擅長維持：安排日常，接住情緒。只是對你來說，把需要說出口比多做一件事更有用。（依據：流年的夫妻宮坐太陰。）

心境上，這一年比較順。你的安定門檻低，有一段沒有人催的時間就夠。只是門檻低也讓你難以離開已經夠好的位置。（依據：流年的福德宮坐天同、天梁；天同化祿落在這裡。）你的心情比較寬鬆，懂得享受生活，也較容易感到滿足。

四化各自的意思：天同化祿（在這一年的福德宮）：你的財祿有增加的機會，而且在運限見到比在本命更好；留意別因安逸而少了進取。天機化權（在這一年的遷移宮）：你的想法較穩定，也更有效率，意見容易被採納，但實權未必在你手上。文昌化科（在這一年的子女宮）：你利於考試、進修和寫作，作品容易有發表的機會。廉貞化忌（在這一年的兄弟宮）：你的感情和人際容易有挫折，替人出力也可能反招怨言；量力而為，別勉強。

天同在你本命化忌，這一年卻化祿：原來不利的地方，這段時期可能轉為有利。

這一年最值得做的事：心境方面是這一年最順的地方，值得多花心思；朋輩方面的決定，多花一點時間再定，急著要答覆的事，先放一晚。

二〇二七年是丁未年，流年命宮轉到未，落在你本命的兄弟宮，坐天相；那一年太陰化祿、巨門化忌。

一年很快過去。把力氣放在順的地方，對要留神的事慢一步，就是這一年最實在的做法。
chapters.en:
2026, the year this book was written, was a Bing Wu year, and you were 35 or 36 (37 by Chinese reckoning). This year, it's smoother going for your inner life, and more care is needed with your peers. This year is one of the key years in your chart, and what you gain and lose this year runs deeper than in an ordinary year.

This year's Life Palace sits in Wu: your birth chart's Partnership Palace, and this decade's Parents Palace, shaped by Ju Men (the Great Gate). This year, you know how to hold back and how to protect yourself; the skill is in knowing when to lower your guard.

This year, at work you like to be out in front; roles facing outwards and dealing with people suit you best. That said, you can get things moving, but you don't always see them through to the end. (Basis: the year's Career Palace holds Tai Yang (the Sun).)

This year, with money, enough is enough: you spend comfortably when there's plenty, and you can tighten your belt when there isn't. That said, you rarely set financial goals, so your savings mostly grow with time alone. (Basis: the year's Wealth Palace has no major star and borrows Tian Tong (the Blessed) and Tian Liang (the Sage) from the opposite palace.)

This year, in love you're good at keeping things going: arranging daily life and catching emotions as they fall. That said, for you, saying what you need is worth more than doing one more thing. (Basis: the year's Partnership Palace holds Tai Yin (the Moon).)

In your inner life, this year runs relatively smoothly. It doesn't take much to settle you: a stretch of time with no one chasing you is enough. That said, being easily settled also makes it hard to leave a place that is already good enough. (Basis: the year's Wellbeing Palace holds Tian Tong and Tian Liang; Tian Tong turning to Abundance falls here.) Your mood is easier, you enjoy life, and you feel content more readily.

What each transformation means: Tian Tong turns to Abundance (in this year's Wellbeing Palace): your income has a chance to grow, and seeing this in a period is better than seeing it in your birth chart; watch that comfort doesn't dull your ambition. Tian Ji (the Strategist) turns to Authority (in this year's Travel Palace): your thinking is steadier and more effective, and your suggestions tend to be adopted, though real power may not be in your hands. Wen Chang turns to Recognition (in this year's Children Palace): this is a good time for exams, further study and writing, and your work may well find a way into print. Lian Zhen (the Upright) turns to Obstruction (in this year's Siblings Palace): your relationships may meet setbacks, and helping others may even earn you complaints; do what you can and don't force it.

Tian Tong turns to Obstruction in your birth chart, but to Abundance this year: what used to work against you may turn in your favour during this period.

The most worthwhile thing to do this year: when it comes to your inner life, this year runs most smoothly, so it's worth giving it extra thought; with decisions about your peers, take a little more time, and let anything that needs an urgent answer wait a night.

2027 is a Ding Wei year: the year's Life Palace moves to Wei, your birth chart's Siblings Palace, shaped by Tian Xiang (the Minister); that year Tai Yin turns to Abundance and Ju Men to Obstruction.

A year passes quickly. Putting your energy where things run smoothly, and going a step slower on what needs care, is the most practical way through this year.

chapters.title: 二 · 兄弟
chapters.zh:
你在朋友之間是協調的那一個，讓場面不至於難看。要留意的是：你兩邊都不得罪，別人也看不清你真正站哪一邊。

你的兄弟宮坐天相。

天相居中協調，使它在群體裡舒服，也使它少有鮮明的立場。

同宮還有陀羅：平輩之間的芥蒂不容易散，過去的事會一直帶著。舊事翻得出來，而且記得細節。

平輩之間的來往相對順，要找人商量或者並肩做一件事，起手的門檻比較低。放在整張盤看：朋友圈裡，紫微在群體裡自然被推到中心；家裡，廉貞要的是合乎自己規格的空間，寧可推翻重來也不將就；身心上，天府的消耗來自長期的警覺。

朋友之間有矛盾時，你常常是兩邊傳話、找台階的人；群組裡有人吵起來，你會先把話題引開。
chapters.en:
Among friends you're the one who coordinates, keeping things from turning awkward. Keep in mind that, because you never offend either side, people can't tell where you really stand.

Your Siblings Palace is shaped by Tian Xiang (the Minister).

Coordinating from the middle makes you comfortable in a group, and leaves you with few clear positions.

Tuo Luo (the Weight) also sits here, slowing things down so they linger: grudges with peers don't easily clear, and the past gets carried along. Old matters can be dug up again, details and all.

Dealings with peers go relatively smoothly; finding someone to talk things over with or to work alongside is easy to start. Seen across the whole chart, the picture fills out. In your circle, Zi Wei (the Emperor) naturally puts you at the centre of a group. At home, Lian Zhen (the Upright) has you want a space built to your own specification, and you'd rather start again than make do. In body and mind, Tian Fu (the Treasury) wears you down through long-term vigilance.

When friends fall out, you're often the one carrying messages between them and finding a way for both to back down. If an argument breaks out in the group chat, you're the first to change the subject.

chapters.title: 三 · 夫妻
chapters.zh:
你在感情裡要把事情講清楚，不喜歡含糊。要留意的是：你的在意常以質疑出現，對方接收到的往往只有質疑。

你的夫妻宮坐巨門。

巨門要講清楚，使關係少有積壓的誤會，也使日常摩擦頻率偏高——因為不是每件事都需要講清楚。

同宮還有地劫：關係裡投入的部分不容易被看見；你付出了甚麼，可以說出來。

這一面也受其他幾宮牽動：心境上，太陽的安定來自有事可做、有人可顧；工作上是天機、在外時是天同，各自那一章另有細講。

伴侶說的話有含糊的地方，你會追問到底；你是想了解，對方聽起來卻像被質問，先說「我在意」再問，效果會好很多。
chapters.en:
In love you need things said clearly; you don't like vagueness. The catch is that your caring often comes out as questioning, and questioning is all your partner hears.

Your Partnership Palace is shaped by Ju Men (the Great Gate).

This means few buried misunderstandings, and also more everyday friction — because not everything needs spelling out.

Di Jie (Loss) also sits here, making gains harder to hold on to: what you put into a relationship isn't easily seen; you can say what you've given.

Other parts of the chart pull on this side of you as well. In your inner life, Tai Yang (the Sun) lets you find calm in having something to do and someone to look after. At work it is Tian Ji (the Strategist) and out in the world it is Tian Tong (the Blessed), each covered in its own chapter.

When your partner says something vague, you keep asking until it's clear. You want to understand, but to them it sounds like an interrogation; saying "this matters to me" before you ask will go much better.

chapters.title: 四 · 子女
chapters.zh:
你帶後輩投入很深，要求到位，不接受敷衍。要留意的是：你的在意本身就有重量，對方可能感到壓迫。

你的子女宮坐廉貞、貪狼。

廉貞對培養的方式：它投入極深，也把自己的原則整套交出去。對後輩或自己的作品，它要求到位、要求認真，不接受敷衍。降低期待，比降低標準更難。貪狼對培養的姿態：它把好玩的東西帶給對方——新的領域、新的玩法、不設限的嘗試。貪狼這樣帶人，啟發性強，也容易缺乏持續：它自己的興趣轉了，帶著的那件事就停在半路。

你在培育一件事或一個人的時候，手上可用的東西比較多，不必事事親力親為。在別的地方，這一面是這樣出現的：對長輩時，武曲不太懂得迂迴，認為對就堅持，認為不對就直說；家裡是廉貞、朋友圈裡是紫微，各自那一章另有細講。

你和孩子或後輩的感情很深，就算意見不合、隔膜一段時間，最後也能互相體諒；你的期望，別讓它變成對方的壓力。
chapters.en:
You invest deeply in those you bring up, expect things done properly, and won't accept half-measures. The trade-off is that your caring has weight of its own, and they may feel pressed by it.

Your Children Palace is shaped by Lian Zhen (the Upright) and Tan Lang (the Wolf).

When you bring others up, Lian Zhen has you invest deeply and hand over your whole set of principles with it. With juniors or your own work, you expect things done properly and seriously, and won't accept half-measures. Lowering expectations is harder than lowering standards. Tan Lang adds curiosity and play to the way you guide others — new fields, new ways of doing things, trying without limits. This is very inspiring, and can also lack staying power: once your own interest moves on, what you were leading stalls halfway.

When you're nurturing a project or a person, you have more to work with, and you don't have to do everything yourself. Elsewhere in the chart, this side of you shows up like this. With elders and seniors, Wu Qu (the General) has you hold to what you think is right and say so plainly when something is wrong. At home it is Lian Zhen and in your circle it is Zi Wei (the Emperor), each covered in its own chapter.

Your bond with children and younger people runs deep; even after a disagreement or a spell of distance, you come to understand each other in the end. Just don't let your expectations turn into pressure on them.

chapters.title: 五 · 財帛
chapters.zh:
你對錢是慢慢積：小額、長期、不聲張。要留意的是：你最怕的不是錢少，是突然的支出。

你的財帛宮坐太陰。

《全書》寫「入廟富足倉箱，陷宮成敗不聚」，核心在聚與不聚。它對開銷敏感，對突然的支出尤其不安。廟旺時積得住，落陷時同樣的用力會變成反覆。它怕的不是少，是突然。

同宮還有地空：計劃與實際收支之間常有缺口，帳目要多看一次。

資源進出的條件較多，來路和去路往往不在同一條線上。同一種底色，延伸到盤上別處：性格上，天同的基調是和緩；心境上是太陽、工作上是天機，各自那一章另有細講。

你習慣小額、長期地儲錢：定期存款、按月供款、為某個目標開一個戶口；突如其來的大額開支最讓你不安，預留一筆應急錢很重要。
chapters.en:
With money you build up slowly: small amounts, over a long time, without fuss. The other side of this is that what you fear most isn't having little money but a sudden expense.

Your Wealth Palace is shaped by Tai Yin (the Moon).

The Complete Book says "full granaries when strong; when weak, gains and losses that don't add up" — the heart of it is whether money gathers or not. You're sensitive to spending, and especially uneasy about sudden expenses. When it's strong, the savings hold; when it's weak, the same effort turns into going back and forth. What you fear isn't too little; it's the sudden.

Di Kong (Void) also sits here, adding a streak of the ideal over the practical: there's often a gap between planned and actual spending, so check the accounts twice.

Your money rarely moves in a straight line: what comes in and what goes out tend to follow different paths. The same pattern carries into other parts of the chart. In your character, Tian Tong (the Blessed) gives you a gentle keynote. In your inner life it is Tai Yang (the Sun) and at work it is Tian Ji (the Strategist), each covered in its own chapter.

You tend to save small amounts over a long time: fixed deposits, monthly standing orders, an account opened for a particular goal. A sudden large expense is what unsettles you most, so an emergency fund matters.

chapters.title: 六 · 疾厄
chapters.zh:
你的疲累來自長期的警覺，平靜時也在防備。要留意的是：你需要一段確定甚麼都不用準備的時間。

你的疾厄宮坐天府。

《全書》寫「天府災少臨災有救」：你的底子穩，消耗多半撐得住。天府的消耗來自警覺：它習慣預先想好萬一，於是即使風平浪靜也在維持一份防備。這種長期低度的緊張不劇烈，卻不容易間斷。對你而言，真正的休息不是停下來，而是有一段時間確定不需要準備什麼。有底比有閒更能讓你鬆下來。天府化科，守成被整理成制度，穩定有了名目。天府只有這一化，所以它出現時份量不輕。

你手上通常留得住一點餘力，不至於所有事情同時壓到底。放在整張盤看：朋輩之間，天相是協調的那一個，把不同的意見接上，讓場面不至於難看；對長輩時是武曲、家裡是廉貞，各自那一章另有細講。

就算事情順利，你心裡也在預備最壞的情況；把保險、備用金、後備方案準備好，你反而能真正放鬆。

此章不涉醫療判斷。
chapters.en:
Your tiredness comes from long-term vigilance; even when things are calm, you're on guard. What you need is a stretch of time when you know for certain there's nothing to prepare for.

Your Health Palace is shaped by Tian Fu (the Treasury).

The Complete Book says Tian Fu brings "few troubles, and help when trouble comes": your foundations are steady, and you can usually bear what wears you down. What wears you down is vigilance: you're in the habit of planning for the worst, so even in calm weather you stay on guard. This long, low-level tension isn't intense, but it rarely lets up. For you, real rest isn't stopping; it's a stretch of time when you know there's nothing to prepare for. Having something in reserve relaxes you more than having free time. Tian Fu turns to Recognition: holding steady is shaped into a system, and stability gets a name. This is Tian Fu's only transformation, so when it appears it carries real weight.

You can usually keep a little strength in reserve, so everything doesn't press down at once. Seen across the whole chart, the picture fills out. Among your peers, Tian Xiang (the Minister) makes you the coordinator, joining up different views and keeping things from turning awkward. With elders and seniors it is Wu Qu (the General) and at home it is Lian Zhen (the Upright), each covered in its own chapter.

Even when things are going well, part of you is preparing for the worst. With insurance, savings and a backup plan in place, you can actually relax.

This chapter makes no medical judgements.

chapters.title: 七 · 遷移
chapters.zh:
你在新環境討人喜歡，融入得快，別人願意幫你。要留意的是：你一去就留下，留下的理由多半是習慣，不是判斷。

此宮無主星，借對宮天同、天梁參看。

天同在陌生環境裡討人喜歡：態度軟、不帶攻擊性，別人願意幫它一把。

天同換環境的阻力小，融入得快。難處在於融入之後——新的舒適區一旦成形，它又不太願意再動。融入的容易與離開的困難，其實是同一種性質。天梁在陌生環境往往遇到願意提攜它的人，原因不難理解：它可靠、講原則、不會給人添麻煩。它在外的適應不靠圓滑，靠的是讓人放心。

在陌生的環境裡要應付的條件較多，離開熟悉的地方之後，重新架起節奏往往要花時間。這一面也受其他幾宮牽動：感情上，巨門要把事情講清楚，不喜歡含糊帶過；性格上是天同、心境上是太陽，各自那一章另有細講。

你到了外地往往遇到願意幫你的人，旅行、外派都容易過得順心；在新地方安頓好了，也要定期問自己想不想再往前走。
chapters.en:
In new surroundings you're easy to like, you settle in quickly, and people want to help you. What complicates this is that once you go somewhere you tend to stay, more out of habit than judgement.

This palace holds no major star of its own, so it is read through Tian Tong (the Blessed) and Tian Liang (the Sage) in the opposite palace.

Tian Tong makes people warm to you quickly in unfamiliar places: you're soft in manner and never aggressive, so people want to give you a hand.

You meet little resistance when you change surroundings, and you fit in quickly. The difficulty comes after fitting in — once a new comfort zone forms, you don't want to move again. Fitting in easily and leaving with difficulty are really the same quality. Tian Liang often brings you people willing to help you along in unfamiliar places, and it's easy to see why: you're reliable, principled and never make trouble for anyone. You adapt away from home not by being smooth but by being trustworthy.

There's more to handle in unfamiliar surroundings, and after leaving familiar ground it usually takes time to find your rhythm again. Other parts of the chart pull on this side of you as well. In love, Ju Men (the Great Gate) has you need things said clearly, with nothing glossed over. In your character it is Tian Tong and in your inner life it is Tai Yang (the Sun), each covered in its own chapter.

Wherever you go, you tend to meet people willing to help you, so travel and postings abroad usually go smoothly. Once you've settled somewhere new, ask yourself now and then whether you want to move on.

chapters.title: 八 · 僕役
chapters.zh:
你在朋友之間自然被推到中心，大家尊重你、依賴你。要留意的是：你給得出方向，未必給得出親近，深交因此不多。

你的僕役宮坐紫微、破軍。

紫微的人脈通常不薄，深交卻不多。群體給你位置，未必給你親近，這個落差本身就是消耗。破軍在群體裡是帶頭改變的那一個：它提得出新做法，也承擔得起反對。這使它有一批跟隨的人，同時有一批被它衝撞過的人。

人群裡的來往相對通，要接上一條線、找到一個人，路徑比較短。在別的地方，這一面是這樣出現的：帶後輩時，廉貞投入極深，也把自己的原則整套交出去；朋輩之間是天相、對長輩時是武曲，各自那一章另有細講。

在公司或朋友圈裡，大家常找你拿主意、做決定；尊重你的人多，能跟你說心事的人少，偶爾主動約一兩個人單獨吃飯。
chapters.en:
Among friends you're naturally pushed to the centre; people respect you and rely on you. Keep in mind that you can give direction more easily than closeness, so you have few deep friendships.

Your Friends Palace is shaped by Zi Wei (the Emperor) and Po Jun (the Vanguard).

Your network is usually substantial, but deep friendships are few. A group gives you a position but not necessarily closeness, and that gap is a drain in itself. Po Jun makes you the one who leads change in a group: you can propose new ways of doing things and bear the opposition. So you have your followers, and also people you've run up against.

Dealings within a group flow relatively freely; making a connection or finding someone takes fewer steps. Elsewhere in the chart, this side of you shows up like this. With those you bring up, Lian Zhen (the Upright) has you invest deeply and hand over your whole set of principles with it. Among your peers it is Tian Xiang (the Minister) and with elders and seniors it is Wu Qu (the General), each covered in its own chapter.

At work and among friends, people often come to you for a decision. Many respect you, but few can tell you what's on their minds; now and then, invite one or two of them for a meal on their own.

chapters.title: 九 · 官祿
chapters.zh:
你做事擅長拆解和變通，在限制裡找空間。要留意的是：你面對長期重複、不容更動的工作，最容易失去耐性。

你的官祿宮坐天機。

做事這件事在你這裡條件較多：要成一件事，往往得先把不相干的東西擺平。感情上是巨門、錢方面是太陰、性格上是天同，各自那一章另有細講。

你適合變化多的工作：項目制、顧問、策劃、需要常常應變的崗位；日日重複、流程固定的職位，最容易讓你坐不住。
chapters.en:
At work you're good at taking things apart and adapting, and finding room inside limits. Watch that long, repetitive work that can't be changed is where you lose patience fastest.

Your Career Palace is shaped by Tian Ji (the Strategist).

Your work rarely stands on its own: to get one thing done, you often have to settle unrelated matters first. In love it is Ju Men (the Great Gate), with money it is Tai Yin (the Moon) and in your character it is Tian Tong (the Blessed), each covered in its own chapter.

You're suited to varied work: project-based roles, consultancy, planning, jobs that keep you adapting. A post where every day is the same and the process is fixed will make you restless fastest.

chapters.title: 十 · 田宅
chapters.zh:
你對住處要合乎自己的規格，寧可推倒重來也不將就。要留意的是：你每一次改造都要投入不少成本。

此宮無主星，借對宮廉貞、貪狼參看。

廉貞：改造的成本高，但對它而言那筆錢花得值。

貪狼對居所的態度偏向可換：它不把某個地方當作終點，也容易因為新的機會而搬動。空間對它的意義是可能性——這裡能不能做點什麼，比住不住得舒服更要緊。

要安頓下來，阻力比較小：住處和家裡的事，多半順手。帶後輩時是廉貞、身心上是天府、朋輩之間是天相，各自那一章另有細講。

你對住處的格局和氛圍很講究，搬進去之前常常想改一改間隔、燈光和擺設；裝修的預算，最好預先定好上限。
chapters.en:
Your home has to meet your own specification; you'd rather start again than make do. The risk is that every remodel costs you a good deal.

This palace holds no major star of its own, so it is read through Lian Zhen (the Upright) and Tan Lang (the Wolf) in the opposite palace.

Lian Zhen: Remodelling costs a lot, but to you the money is well spent.

Tan Lang has you see a home as something you can swap: no place is a final stop, and you'll readily move for a new opportunity. To you, a space means possibility — whether something can be done there matters more than whether it's comfortable to live in.

Settling in meets less resistance: matters of home and household mostly go smoothly. With those you bring up it is Lian Zhen, in body and mind it is Tian Fu (the Treasury) and among your peers it is Tian Xiang (the Minister), each covered in its own chapter.

You're particular about the layout and feel of a home, and before moving in you often want to change the floor plan, the lighting and the furnishings. Set a ceiling on the renovation budget in advance.

chapters.title: 十一 · 福德
chapters.zh:
你要有事可做、有人可顧才安心，完全空下來反而不安。要留意的是：你做了很多卻沒人看見時，最容易耗損。

你的福德宮坐太陽。

完全空下來時，太陽反而不安。太陽的精神狀態與忙碌程度的關係，跟多數人相反：適度的負荷是它的地面。真正令它耗損的不是事情多，是事情做了卻沒有人看見，或者對象根本不需要。被需要，是你最實在的安定來源。太陽化祿，付出接得回回應，照出去的地方真的亮起來。它讓太陽的給予不再是空轉。

同宮還有鈴星：心事不外露，安靜並不代表已經放下。

內在安放自己的條件較多，想要靜下來，往往要先把幾件事放好。錢方面是太陰、在外時是天同、感情上是巨門，各自那一章另有細講。

你的自尊心強，做了事希望被看見、被肯定；空閒時你寧願幫人、做義工、辦活動，也不想一個人閒著。
chapters.en:
You feel at ease with something to do and someone to look after; complete emptiness unsettles you. The catch is that you wear down fastest when you've done a great deal and no one has noticed.

Your Wellbeing Palace is shaped by Tai Yang (the Sun).

With nothing at all to do, Tai Yang leaves you uneasy rather than rested. With Tai Yang here, the link between busyness and peace of mind runs the opposite way from most people's: a reasonable load is what keeps you grounded. What really wears you down isn't having a lot to do; it's doing things no one sees, or for people who don't need them. Being needed is your most solid source of calm. Tai Yang turns to Abundance: what you give gets a response, and where you shine really lights up. This stops your giving from spinning its wheels.

Ling Xing (Bell) also sits here, adding a slow, hidden heat: worries don't show, and quiet doesn't mean you've let go.

You don't find inner rest easily; to quieten down, you often have to put a few things in order first. With money it is Tai Yin (the Moon), out in the world it is Tian Tong (the Blessed) and in love it is Ju Men (the Great Gate), each covered in its own chapter.

You have a lot of pride and want what you do to be seen and recognised. In your free time you'd rather help people, volunteer or organise something than sit idle on your own.

chapters.title: 十二 · 父母
chapters.zh:
你對長輩和上司直來直往，認為不對就直說。要留意的是：你的立場清楚，衝突也來得快。

你的父母宮坐武曲、七殺。

武曲直來直往，使關係裡的立場清楚，也使衝突來得快。它對規則的態度同樣直接——合理就遵守，不合理就繞過去，較少花時間在程序上與人周旋。七殺不服軟，也不擅長迂迴——認為不對就不配合，而且不會花時間解釋。七殺不服軟，使和長輩的關係緊張而清楚。武曲化權，決斷有了授權，敢下手也下得了手。要留意剛加上權容易過猛。方向對就推得遠，方向錯就撞得重。

同宮還有擎羊：對長輩與規則的態度直接，少有迂迴。意見不同會當場說出來。

與長輩、與權威之間相對談得通，要交代一件事的路徑比較直接。身心上是天府、朋友圈裡是紫微、帶後輩時是廉貞，各自那一章另有細講。

你和上司、長輩相處直來直往，覺得不對就說；遞交報告、處理文件時，多花一點時間在程序上，能省下不少麻煩。
chapters.en:
With elders and managers you're straightforward; if you think something is wrong, you say so. The trade-off is that your position is clear, so conflict arrives quickly.

Your Parents Palace is shaped by Wu Qu (the General) and Qi Sha (the Warrior).

Being straightforward keeps positions clear, and makes conflict arrive quickly. You're just as direct with rules — you follow the sensible ones and go around the rest, spending little time working the system with people. Qi Sha makes you unwilling to soften your position once you believe something is wrong — you won't cooperate, and you won't spend time explaining. Not backing down makes relationships with elders tense, though clear. Wu Qu turns to Authority: your decisiveness is sanctioned, and you dare to act and can. The other side of this is that firmness plus authority can easily go too far. In the right direction you push far; in the wrong one you hit hard.

Qing Yang (the Blade) also sits here, adding a blunt, cutting edge: a direct approach to elders and rules, with little diplomacy. Disagreement gets said on the spot.

Things are relatively easy to talk through with elders and authority, and the route for explaining something is more direct. In body and mind it is Tian Fu (the Treasury), in your circle it is Zi Wei (the Emperor) and with those you bring up it is Lian Zhen (the Upright), each covered in its own chapter.

You're straightforward with managers and elders, and you say when you think something is wrong. Spending a little more time on procedure when you submit reports and paperwork will save you a lot of trouble.

chapters.title: 給你的話
chapters.zh:
你有自己的節奏，不急不躁，適合在穩定的環境裡發揮。

你可以倚仗的：一、你的長處是穩當、可靠，做事有條理。二、工作上，你做事擅長拆解和變通，在限制裡找空間。三、心境上，你要有事可做、有人可顧才安心，完全空下來反而不安。

你要記住的：一、舒服會削弱你前進的動力，有時你需要一點外來的推力。二、感情上，你的在意常以質疑出現，對方接收到的往往只有質疑。三、你選擇工作和環境時，先想清楚自己要悠閒還是要進取。

這十年最值得做的事：長輩關係方面是這十年最順的地方，值得多花心思；感情方面的決定，多花一點時間再定，簽字、承諾之前多問一句。這一年最值得做的事：心境方面是這一年最順的地方，值得多花心思；朋輩方面的決定，多花一點時間再定，急著要答覆的事，先放一晚。

命書寫的是一張底圖。往後的路怎樣走，仍然在你；需要的時候，再翻回來看看。
chapters.en:
You have your own pace, unhurried and even, and you do best in a stable environment.

What you can rely on: first, your strength is being steady and reliable, with an orderly way of working. Second, at work you're good at taking things apart and adapting, and finding room inside limits. Third, in your inner life, you feel at ease with something to do and someone to look after; complete emptiness unsettles you.

What to keep in mind: first, that ease has a cost: when life is too comfortable your drive softens, and change comes more easily when something outside pushes you. Second, in love, your caring often comes out as questioning, and questioning is all your partner hears. Third, when choosing work and surroundings, it helps to be clear whether you want ease or ambition.

The most worthwhile thing to do in these ten years: when it comes to your ties with elders, these ten years run most smoothly, so it's worth giving it extra thought; with decisions about your love life, take a little more time, and ask one more question before you sign or commit to anything. The most worthwhile thing to do this year: when it comes to your inner life, this year runs most smoothly, so it's worth giving it extra thought; with decisions about your peers, take a little more time, and let anything that needs an urgent answer wait a night.

This book is a base map. How you walk the road ahead is still up to you; come back to these pages whenever you need them.
